summary: Compression with a three-byte dictionary reaches a four-byte candidate read in get_batch, causing an out-of-bounds panic with default safe-encode enabled. The fix treats dictionaries shorter than the four-byte minimum match as empty. The regression test added by the fix exercises this case. The proposed reversal restores the exact parent implementation while preserving the test; reproduction has not been run.
expected_failure: range end index 4 out of range for slice of length 3
